profile.title: Profile
profile.bio: My name is Tania Brandt, I am in my 50s, married and have two children. I offer psychological treatment to adults. I have specialized in Cognitive Therapy. I also offer supervision to psychologists who want to obtain their authorization. I am both a clinical and occupational psychologist. I am authorized by the Danish Psychology Association and have more than 20 years of experience. At the end of 2025 I will be a specialist in therapy for adults. I participate in courses and receive continuous supervision in my work. I specialize in evaluation, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of risks of mental health problems and maladaptive behaviors that can affect the workplace due to psychological disorders. I have experience in treating psychological problems in the workplace because I have worked in private companies helping people on sick leave who have returned to work. Welcome to your space to improve your emotional well-being. For me, the therapeutic process begins with mutual collaboration based on trust, respect, empathy and openness that is important for reflecting on the problems you face in your life and your psychological well-being. It is also important for me to know and understand your needs that you are going through in your life. In therapy we will use therapeutic reflection elements specific to your needs. Perhaps you need to understand yourself better, where your vulnerability comes from, how you find peace and how you approach the life you want. I have experience in the public system so I can advise you about your problem regardless of whether you need my help or if you require an interdisciplinary team in the hospital sector. I hope I can help you. Welcome!

online_therapy.title: Online Therapy
online_therapy.content:
I also offer online therapy, which is also known as remote therapy or e-therapy.

You can receive professional help in safe settings, regardless of where you are. There are many benefits such as:

• You get access to specialized psychological help without geographical limitations.

• You schedule sessions that fit into your daily life.

• You receive therapy in your own safe surroundings.

• You avoid transportation and wasted time associated with traveling to my clinic.

• You avoid taking time off from work.

All online sessions take place over a GDPR-secured and encrypted video connection.

The online therapy process is tailored to you. It is structured and targeted with a focus on giving you the necessary tools to handle your challenges.

I look forward to supporting you towards better mental well-being.

treatment.title: Treatment
treatment.introduction:
I have a 2-year education in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (Treatment of stress, anxiety, depression, substance abuse, etc.)

Additionally, I am trained in Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (managing and regulating emotions) and in Prolonged Exposure (trauma treatment).

I have also completed several complementary courses in Compassion Focused Therapy, Metacognitive Therapy, Solution Focused Therapy, among other modalities.

In recent years, I have worked in adult psychiatry, gaining experience in diagnostic assessment. Currently, I continue working in a psychiatric outpatient clinic.

The psychological sessions I offer are based on the most current strategies of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. The treatment is personalized and adapted to your individual needs, goals and desires.

I use different therapeutic approaches depending on what is most relevant and meaningful for you, and we continuously evaluate the process to ensure that you truly benefit from therapy.

practical.title: Practical Information
practical.condition_1: I am an authorized psychologist and member of the Danish Psychology Association.
practical.condition_2: Sessions can be conducted in Danish, English, Spanish or Portuguese.
practical.condition_3: I also offer telephone consultations and online sessions, but recommend that the first session is in person. It is possible to choose a telephone/video session at the same rate.
practical.confidentiality_text: I am bound by confidentiality for psychologists, which I make a great effort to uphold. In extraordinary cases, I may be forced to break my confidentiality if I learn that you are in danger to either yourself or others. In cases where I gain knowledge or have strong suspicion that a child is suffering or overburdened, I have, like everyone else, a duty to report. I will always talk to you about it if I consider breaking our confidential space before I talk to others.
practical.cancellation_text: Cancellations must be made 24 hours before the session starts - otherwise you must expect a fee of {{cancellationFee}}. Cancellations can also be made by phone call, voicemail message, SMS or email. An appointment with physical attendance can always be converted to a telephone session if you experience symptoms of illness and/or cannot attend in person. The same rate applies.
practical.payment_text_1: I do not have a provider number and no agreement with health insurance. Therefore, I unfortunately do not receive referrals from your own doctor. See a list of psychologists with provider numbers at psykologeridanmark.dk
practical.payment_text_2: Sygeforsikring Danmark provides subsidies for treatment of various mental disorders by authorized psychologists for members in groups 1, 2 and 5. Read the conditions here
practical.payment_text_3: If you have health insurance or health plan through your insurance company or work, you can contact them to hear if they will cover psychological help. Get help understanding the conditions here
practical.payment_method_text: Payment is made with MobilePay or cash with receipt after each consultation. I do not accept credit cards.
practical.payment_method_insurance: If you have an authorization from your health insurance, I will ensure that the invoice is sent to them if the insurance covers the full amount. If your insurance does not cover the full amount, you must pay upfront and arrange for reimbursement from your insurance yourself.
practical.payment_private_text: Payment must be made in advance - cash / via mobilepay before each session. I do not accept credit cards.
practical.payment_private_note: Note: You cannot use a referral from your doctor with me, as I do not have an agreement with health insurance.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: I look forward to hearing from you if you have any questions. If my phone is busy, please leave a message and I will call you back as soon as possible; otherwise, send a confidential email to tania@mentisbalance.dk.
contact.parking: There is free parking very close to the premises, which is also about a 5-minute walk from Nørrebro station.
